observations: Two manual drum pumps with brass-colored heads and metal handles.
Two white plastic lids with central bosses.
One lid has a blue label with '100L' printed on it.
The items are photographed on a tiled floor.
Watermark 'QUESTMARK ENTERPRISES POSTED ON JIJI' is visible across the center.

claims.evidence: The 100L lid in photo 0 suggests a 100L capacity, not 200L.
The diameter of the pump head opening is not clearly legible in photo 0.
The pump heads and handles in photo 0 are metallic and appear silver/gold, not red.

claims.claim: Fully working, recently serviced by the dealer, all parts complete. Original from the manufacturer.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The pump may not function or may leak.
risks.proof: A video showing the pump being operated to draw liquid.

risks.risk: The pump may be for a 100L drum rather than a 200L drum.
risks.proof: A photo of the pump head with a measuring tape showing the internal diameter.

risks.risk: The pump may be missing the rubber gasket mentioned in the description.
risks.proof: A photo showing the rubber gasket installed in the pump head.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the pump being operated to demonstrate it works.
Photo of the pump head with a measuring tape to confirm the 200L capacity.
Photo of the rubber gasket to confirm it is included.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
